newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Los Angeles MTA refunding.

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority
(California)
Proposition A First Tier Senior Sales Tax Revenue Refunding
Bonds, Series 1997-A
The Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation
Authority (the Authority'') intends to receive sealed bids from Qualified Bidders for the above Bonds (the
Bonds
until 9:00 a.m., California Time, on THURSDAY,

at the offices of the Authority, One Gateway Plaza, Treasury Department, 21st Floor, Los Angeles, California 90012 (at Union Station). The Authority reserves the right to postpone, from time to time, the date established for the receipt of bids. Any such postponement will be announced by Munifacts News Service given not later than 1:00 p.m., New York, New York Time, on the last business date prior to any date scheduled for receipt of bids. If any date fixed for the receipt of bids and the sale of the Bonds is postponed, any alternative sale date (either a Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday) will be announced via Munifacts News Service at least 72 hours prior to such alternative sale date and will also be provided by facsimile transmission to any Qualified Bidder timely

requesting such notice. On any such alternative sale date, any Qualified Bidder may submit a sealed bid for the purchase of the Bonds in conformity in all respects with the provisions of the official Notice Inviting Bids except for the date of sale and except for the changes announced by Munifacts News Service at the time the sale date and time are announced.

The Bonds will be dated June 1, 1997. The principal amount of Bonds to be sold may be decreased prior to the sale of the Bonds and the principal amount of Bonds sold may be adjusted after the award of the Bonds, all as set forth in the Notice Inviting Bids.

Copies of the Notice Inviting Bids, together with copies of the Preliminary Official Statement issued in connection with the sale of the Bonds, the Resolution of the Authority authorizing the issuance of the Bonds, the Trust Agreement and the Supplemental Trust Agreement related thereto may be obtained from the offices of the Authority's financial advisors: Public Resources Advisory Group, 3550 Wilshire Boulevard, Suite 1630, Los Angeles, CA 90010, Attention: Craig A. Hoshijima, (213) 380-9344; Charles A. Bell

Securities Corp., 44 Montgomery Street, Suite 960, San Francisco, CA 94104-2804, Attention: Leonard R. Berry, (415) 433-0270; and P.G. Corbin & Company, Inc., 353 Sacramento Street, Suite 600, San Francisco, CA 94111, Attention: Darlene Cimino-DeRose, (415) 421-1800.
Rod Dawson, Interim Executive Officer, Finance
Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority
* Subject to change as set forth in the Notice Inv
Bids
(From The Bond Buyer)
